title: Apple fiscal 2024 operating data
scope: Demonstration on historical public data; not the latest financial statements and not investment advice

S1.title: Apple FY24 Q4 Consolidated Financial Statements
S1.locator: Page 1, the two Twelve Months Ended columns; page 4, GAAP to Non-GAAP reconciliation
S1.note: Uses the full-year GAAP figures from the unaudited condensed financial statements; fiscal 2024 ended September 28 and fiscal 2023 ended September 30.

S2.title: Apple reports fourth quarter results
S2.summary: The press release says the quarter included a one-time charge related to the European Union tax ruling, and lists risks such as market competition, the supply chain and regulation. Quarterly figures must not be mixed into full-year comparisons.

analysis_notes: Full-year 2024 total revenue rose while products revenue fell and services revenue rose; a contribution in dollars is not a causal explanation.

Operating income rose while net income fell. A one-time income tax charge affected net income, so this alone does not show that the core business got worse, and non-GAAP figures must not replace GAAP figures.
There is no valuation, outlook or competitor data, so the material does not support buy or sell advice.
template_keys: Each series offers <id>_2023, <id>_2024 and <id>_growth (year-over-year percent); there are also services_share_2023, services_share_2024 and tax_charge_2024. Values include units and are computed by prepare.py.
